about:
# Goodwill

A World of Warcraft addon for Classic Era and World of Warcraft: Forever:
every faction's road to Exalted from where you stand, and a chapter of its
story at each standing you reach.

- **The road.** For each faction: how far to the next standing, the turn-ins
  your bags and bank already hold (and how many times they'd go in), the
  quests still open to you, the kills that still count and the standing they
  stop at.
- **The unlocks.** What each standing opens, as the game's items: the
  quartermasters' goods, the recipes (with their trade), the quests.
- **The stories.** Thirty-five factions have a voice of their own: Gorn One
  Eye of the Timbermaw, Duke Nicholas Zverenhoff of the Argent Dawn, Lokhtos
  Darkbargainer of the Thorium Brotherhood and thirty-two more tell you a
  little more at every standing you reach with them, from the stranger's
  warning to what they keep for those they trust.
- **The achievements.** The book keeps its own: your first gain with a
  faction, the standings you reach, whole groups at Exalted and the stories
  you open, each with the game's fanfare and alert.

English and French. `/goodwill` opens the book.

The settings also offer the book's size (four steps) and paper colours (dark ink on tan paper, applied by a
reload: the page ends with a Reload button). **Options > Key Bindings** lists **Open Goodwill**: one key,
or on Forever a controller button, opens and closes the book. Nothing is bound until you choose.

The game's data comes from [wow-data](https://github.com/salty-max/wow-data):
the game clients' tables, [Questie](https://github.com/Questie/Questie)'s
database and the [cmangos](https://github.com/cmangos/classic-db) Classic
database.

MIT licence.

releases.notes:
Goodwill 0.4.0

- New: **Book size** makes the whole window larger, in four steps from Normal to Largest, and **Paper colours** show dark ink on tan paper instead of the dark look. Both are in the settings. Paper colours apply after a reload, and the settings page now ends with a Reload button and a line saying so.
- New: a key binding. **Options > Key Bindings** lists **Open Goodwill** under a heading of its own, so one key, or on Forever a controller button, opens and closes the book. Nothing is bound until you choose.
- On Forever, the window now tells the Gamepad UI that it is open, so a controller's D-pad can move across its buttons.
- On Forever with the Gamepad UI on, the game can show its blocked-action popup after an options page opens. That is a bug in the game's own Gamepad UI. A reload clears it, and the settings page now says so.
- The game's data is brought up to date.

Fixed: the list on the left of the book now starts right under the search box, with no empty space above the first entry.
Updated for the game's latest Forever build.

Goodwill 0.3.0

- A pass over the chapters: British spelling, stock phrases out of fifteen voices, invented politics cut and every aside titled.
- The next chapter is now said in one sentence.
- French is finished: voices rewritten from the English, real and unique titles, Classic Era names by id, and the client's spacing.
- The interface is in English and French. German and Spanish stay English for now.

Goodwill's first release on CurseForge and Wago (it has been on GitHub since 0.1.0).
- Achievements for your standings, with the game's own alert when you earn one: a first gain with a faction, reaching standings, whole groups at Exalted.
- A chapter of each faction's story at each standing, and the stories count only factions you can raise.
- Only the factions your character can actually earn are listed, and the overview counts out of what your side can raise.
- A faction appears on its first gain of reputation, and a character's own factions from the start. Old books keep untouched hostile factions out.
- Start standings follow each race's real starting reputation.
- The chapters are set in the family's voice, and a new chapter is announced as a link.
- French, German and Spanish read again.

Goodwill 0.1.0

The first release.

- **The road to Exalted, from where you stand.** Open any faction and its page starts at your standing now: what your bags and bank can hand in, the quests still open to you, the kills that still count, and what the next standing unlocks. Sister factions share their reputation the way the game does.
- **A chapter of the faction's story at each standing.** Reach a new standing and a voice from that faction tells you the next chapter, a little more openly each time. Thirty-five factions have a voice, from the Argent Dawn and the Shen'dralar to the Steamwheedle towns, the capitals and the battlegrounds.
- **Classic Era and Forever in one download**, in English, French, German and Spanish. German and Spanish are first translations.
- A slash command, an options page, a switch for the chapter banner, and an achievement for the road's end.
